title: postapiv1authregisterstartvalidrollnumber
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/auth/register/start with a valid roll number and institute email triggers OTP generation and returns a verification challenge.

title: postapiv1authregisterstartinvalidrollnumber
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/auth/register/start with a roll number not found in academic records returns an error indicating invalid or unknown roll number.

title: postapiv1authregisterverifyvalidotp
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/auth/register/verify with a valid OTP and password returns a JWT token and establishes an authenticated session.

title: postapiv1authloginvalidcredentials
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/auth/login with valid institute credentials returns a JWT bearer token, user profile, and active session status.

title: postapiv1authlogininvalidcredentials
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/auth/login with invalid credentials returns an authentication failure response.

title: postapiv1authlogoutvalidsession
description: Verify that POST /api/v1/auth/logout with a valid session token invalidates the session and confirms logout.

title: getapiv1meprofileauthenticated
description: Verify that GET /api/v1/me/profile with an authenticated token returns student profile, completed semesters, current CPI, cumulative CGPA, and target projection.

title: putapiv1metargetvalidcgpa
description: Verify that PUT /api/v1/me/target with a valid target CGPA between 0.00 and 10.00 updates the target and returns required average CPI projection.

title: putapiv1metargetinvalidcgpa
description: Verify that PUT /api/v1/me/target with an invalid CGPA outside the allowed range returns a validation error response.

title: getapiv1academicsrecordsauthenticated
description: Verify that GET /api/v1/academics/records with an authenticated token returns ordered semester-by-semester academic results.
